subject: [PATCH v2 15/17] selftests/mm: race collapse of windows with holes

2026-08-07.patch_summary: This patch modifies the khugepaged_race test to run both ends of the occupancy scale, one after the other, for every driver mode. The test checks for correctness by verifying that every racing page reads as its pattern or zero. The patch also adds a new option -z to narrow a run to the hole-heavy end, and another option -m to narrow it to one mode. This is done to collapse windows with holes, which was not happening before due to the harness pinning max_ptes_none to 0.
